profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I graduated from UW-Stout in the spring of 2021 with a Bachelor of Science degree in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science and a minor in Business Administration. During my time in school I had a variety of Information Technology-related positions where I learned valuable skills regarding IT support. Since graduation, I have been working at Marten Transport as a software developer and now Tension Corporation in the packaging and automation division. My experience lies primarily in full-stack development; working with both the front-end and back-end of application development. In my spare time, I like to work on projects around my house and fix up my motorcycle. I also value spending time with friends and family as a way to recharge and stay connected, both personally and professionally.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
‣ Full stack development with companies legacy software in PowerBuilder and new application
development in WPF .NET Framework.
‣ Developed a dynamic end-user permissions management system for all internal WPF
applications. 
‣ Translated existing application from PowerBuilder to WPF application.
‣ Updated existing internal recruiting API to update third-party recruiting websites.
‣ Developed and modified various PowerBuilder applications and SQL stored procedures based on
incoming user requests.
positions.insights: Help Desk Support, .NET Framework and +10 skills

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description:
‣ Remote technical support, including but not limited to, configuring networks, servers, workstations, etc.
‣ Troubleshooting issues regarding software related to Cornerstone and all other IT-related issues.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: ‣ IT support for the School District of Fort Atkinson, which included working the IT help desk, reloading workstations, troubleshooting IT-related issues and projects.
